create_llm_instance: create an LLM instance with the facebook/opt-125m model and disabled log stats
create_sampling_params: create a SamplingParams object with temperature 0.8 and top_p 0.95
generate_texts_from_prompts: generate text outputs from a list of prompts using the LLM and SamplingParams
retrieve_counter_metrics: retrieve and print Counter metrics from the LLM instance
retrieve_gauge_metrics: retrieve and print Gauge metrics from the LLM instance
